description: Official Inworld AI plugin for Claude Code — the top-rated TTS-2 model with natural-language steering across 200+ languages, hundreds of professional voices plus instant voice cloning & design, STT with voice profiling (age, emotion, accent), Realtime voice agents, and the LLM Router.

api_key.title: Inworld API Key
api_key.description: Your Inworld API key (Base64, from https://platform.inworld.ai/api-keys). No account yet? Sign up free at https://platform.inworld.ai/signup — or leave this blank and run /inworld:setup. You can also export INWORLD_API_KEY in your shell.
